OPEN EVENTS 2026Our open events are now SOLD OUT! However, you can join our waiting list. Find out more here.
GCSE RESULTS DAY 2026We are celebrating fantastic GCSE results across the school with the headline figure at GCSE recording the highest ever result of 49% of all grades at Grade 7 and above. Read more here.
A LEVEL & T LEVEL RESULTS DAY 2026Congratulations to all students who have received their A-level and T Level results. 60% of A-level & T-level grades are at A*/B or equivalent. Overall, 19 students achieved the UCAS three A grades or more. Read more here.
TERM DATES 2026-27Our term dates for 2026-27 can be found here.
SUMMER B NEWSLETTERSOur latest suite of newsletters, including Inform June/July 2026 can be found here.CSI - OUTSTANDING SCHOOLFollowing our recent CSI inspection, we are delighted to report we have been awarded 'Outstanding' across all areas in our Catholic Schools Inspectorate (CSI) Report. Find out more here.
HEADTEACHER'S WEEKLY ROUNDUPWe are delighted to share our Headteacher's Roundup, designed to share a weekly snapshot of school life and news.
“Students explore their faith by becoming young women of action who use their gifts and talents to benefit others..
Our staff go above and beyond in providing the best possible pastoral care, guidance, and support for all our students to ensure all achieve success."
Eoin Kelly Headteacher
Read our full Headteacher Welcome here.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Catholic Schools Inspectorate report on behalf of the Archbishop of Southwark
We are proud to share our published Catholic Schools Inspectorate (CSI) Report, following our inspection earlier this month.
We are over the moon to report that Ursuline High School has been awarded Outstanding across all areas.
The overall judgment of Outstanding (Grade 1) was awarded and we secured Outstanding (Grade 1) in each of the following categories:
The report reflects the outstanding work of the school, the dedication of all the staff and our students hard work and effort.
A big thanks to our school community for your continued support - staff, students and parents/carers.
Alongside our over-subscribed main school and Sixth Form open events, this report really is a lovely end to our first half-term. The report can be found here.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
SSAT Educational Outcomes Awards 2024
Ursuline High School Wimbledon has been recognised in this year’s Educational Outcomes Awards, receiving awards for being for being in the top 10% of schools nationally for student progress and in the top 10% of non-selective schools for student attainment in the 2024 end of KS4 exams. Read more.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DFE Report 'Above Average' Progress and ResultsWe are delighted to report that the DfE as rated our A Level results as 'Above Average'. Results are above national results at A*-A, A*-B and A*-C, and also Above Average for progress made between GCSE and A Level. It is rare for schools like ours, in the top 4% nationally at GCSE, to continue to make positive progress in the 6th form. Well done to all our students and staff!

Religious Education Department Mission Statement
We aspire to be a community where people can know and encounter Christ more clearly; both academically and personally. We aim to express our faith and personal beliefs while encouraging and respecting the beliefs and values of others. We promote Serviam: developing our gifts and talents for the good of others so that our students can confidently and securely put their faith into action.
Religious Education Department Aims
“My daughters really enjoy their RE lessons at Ursuline High School. The teachers are friendly, approachable and skilled at inspiring deep reflection.” – Parent
Introducing Our R.E Team
Kerry Connor – Assistant Headteacher Personal Development and Catholic Life Ethos
I undertook a Bachelor of Divinity (BD Hons) at Heythrop College, a specialist Theology and Philosophy college of the University of London and a PCGE at Edge Hill University. I specialised in biblical languages and philosophy of religion. My dissertation focused on Jewish and Christian responses to the Holocaust.
I have been teaching since 2005. After starting my teaching career in Liverpool I moved to Ursuline High school in 2014. I particularly enjoy teaching the Catholic Christianity component of the GCSE course as I love exploring faith through discussion and debate.
Dr Sulumenty Odhiambo – Head of Faculty / CSI Inspector
I hold a Doctor of Education degree from University College (UCL) a Masters in Education, PGCE-RE from Liverpool Hope University; Bachelor of Philosophy degree from Urbaniana Pontifical University; BA (Hons) Theology for Ministry, Diploma in Missiology and Certificate in Counseling Skills from Middlesex University. In addition I’m a member of Chartered College of Teaching with Certificate in evidence-informed practice, an experienced examiner, both at GCSE and A levels and a member of the Catholic Schools Inspectorate team.
I have been teaching at Ursuline High School since 2005. I particularly enjoy teaching Catholic Christianity at the GCSE level, Ethics and Development in Christian Thoughts at A level, and enthusing KS3 students with inquisitive minds.
James Roberts – RE Teacher, Head of Year 8
I undertook a Bachelor of Arts (BA Hons) at St Mary's University, Twickenham, where I also completed my PGCE. I specialised in Catholic Theology and Biblical Study. My dissertation focused on the Von Balthasar's Theology of Holy Saturday and different interpretations of the Catholic Doctrine surrounding Christ's Descent into Hell.
I have been teaching since 2017 and joined Ursuline High in 2020. I teach KS3-5, including the Philosophy of Religion component for the OCR Religious Studies A Level.
Alex Agotre - RE Teacher
I hold a Bachelor of Philosophy degree from La Pontificia Università Urbaniana, a BA Theology degree from Middlesex University and a Diploma in Religious Studies from Philosophy Centre, Jinja (Uganda). I did my PGCE with Mary Vale Institute in Birmingham and CCRS with Liverpool Hope University. I also have a certificate in Understanding Children’s Mental Health.
I have been teaching for the last 14 years. This is my first year at Ursuline High School. I Love Teaching Catholic Christianity and Judaism beliefs, teachings and practices.
Anna McGrath - RE Teacher
I undertook a Bachelor of Education (BEd Hons) at St Mary’s University Belfast specialising in Religious Studies while also completing my Religious Education Certificate. I graduated in 2023 and completed my Capstone research project on the Transition of Dyslexic Pupils from Primary to Post Primary school. I joined Ursuline High in September 2024 and have enjoyed the incredible sense of faith and community that the school holds.
